title: pane resize handle (drag-to-resize the docked terminal/panel column)

missing_seam.explanation: pane_resize_handle is called only from frame_resize_handle (:230) and pane_split_geometry (:612); both feed only native_pane_resize.rs #[cfg(test)] (lines 862-1300). PaneResize::new is constructed only in tests. The handle requires a docked RightPane::Terminal|Panel (native_pane_resize.rs:286), which the live composition never produces.

why_no_live_consumer: The handle is derived from ShellFrame/FrameDescriptor (frame_resize_handle, native_pane_resize.rs:230; uses FrameDescriptor.available/descriptor.pane). ShellFrame is produced only by compose_shell, which has no non-test caller (see LAY-10). No live code builds a ShellFrame or a FrameDescriptor.

The live geometry (ViewPresentation, native_view.rs:1972-1994) has no pane boundary a handle could sit on: the right column is either the docked 42-col sidebar (sidebar_offset) or, below 120 cols, an overlay; there is no terminal/panel dock and no pane-resize width stored in the live view.

The live input loop has no drag handler that drives PaneResize: grep for on_mouse_drag/PaneResize/pane_resize/resize_handle in tui_entry.rs matches only an unrelated comment (tui_entry.rs:9879). PaneResize::on_mouse_down/on_mouse_drag/on_mouse_up are never invoked live.
pane_split_geometry (:612) and frame_resize_handle (:230) also have no production caller (grep over crates/ returns only their definitions plus tests).
required_producer: A live docked terminal/panel column in the running render (see LAY-10 required producer) so a RightPane::Terminal|Panel boundary exists.

A live pointer path: tui_entry's mouse dispatch must construct a PaneResize bound to the live frame geometry (paneResize createPaneResize equivalent, session-frame.tsx:45-67), place the handle from the frame descriptor (session-frame.tsx:381-384), and route down/drag/up + double-click into it.
Live persistence of the committed width into the same storage the live view reads for the dock width (upstream stores layout.paneWidth, session-frame.tsx:42-55).
blocking_reason: pane_resize_handle/PaneResize exist and are correct-looking but have no production caller and no producible docked pane to attach to. Wiring them requires the LAY-10 live panel/terminal dock plus a live mouse-drag path, neither of which exists. Not bounded.
focused_test_plan: n/a (blocked). Existing coverage is test-only: native_pane_resize.rs:878-1300 (handle target/highlight, drag clamp, release persistence, double-click reset, frame placement).
